preconditions.expression: t > 0 and all(3 <= n <= 1000 for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('a_') and not line.startswith('b_')))
preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is at least 1, and for each test case, the number of caves n satisfies 3 ≤ n ≤ 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(n <= m <= min((n * (n - 1)) // 2, 2000) for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('a_') and not line.startswith('b_')))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of tunnels m satisfies n ≤ m ≤ min((n(n-1))/2, 2000).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in (line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.startswith('a_'))[0])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the monster power values a_i satisfy 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in (line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.startswith('b_'))[0])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the power increase values b_i satisfy 1 ≤ b_i ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('a_') and not line.startswith('b_') and not line.startswith('n') and not line.startswith('m')))
preconditions.description: For each test case, each tunnel connects two distinct caves u_i and v_i, where 1 ≤ u_i, v_i ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(tunnel)) == 2 for tunnel in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('a_') and not line.startswith('b_') and not line.startswith('n') and not line.startswith('m')))
preconditions.description: No two caves are connected with more than one tunnel.

preconditions.expression: all(len(adj) >= 2 for adj in (build_adjacency_list(n, tunnels) for n, tunnels in (parse_test_case(stdin))))
preconditions.description: Every cave has at least two tunnels connected to it, ensuring no dead ends.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, int) for output in (line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single integer representing the smallest possible initial power.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output <= 10**9 for output in (line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a valid power value between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(can_pass_level(n, a, b, tunnels, output) for n, a, b, tunnels, output in (parse_test_case_with_output(stdin, stdout)))
postconditions.description: The output is the smallest initial power such that the hero can traverse all caves, defeat all monsters, and never get stuck, following the movement rules.
